title: PlaySlot: Controllable Object-Centric Video Prediction
description: A video prediction model that learns object representations and latent actions from unlabeled video.
body: Our paper was accepted for publication at ICML 2025.

PlaySlot generates multiple possible sequence continuations conditioned on past object states and latent actions. Those actions can be inferred from video dynamics, provided by a user, or generated by a learned action policy.
